svg.title: Qualify what you ship
svg.desc: Check the exact candidate. A change invalidates affected checks; production and real-use observations remain separate claims. System model: Qualify the candidate you actually ship.. Exact candidate Source · scope Identity. CHECKS PASS?. Production Deploy; inspect live identity. Real use People · devices Separate evidence. STOP / THE CANDIDATE CHANGED Earlier checks no longer qualify this state. Revise and repeat the affected checks.. Check, production and real-use claims each need their own evidence. A changed candidate invalidates affected earlier checks.
